title: Harden GitHub token handling during repository checkout
description:
Context: Final read-only review of repository analysis pipeline work found existing token handling outside the current implementation scope.
Problem: Private repo GitHub tokens are embedded in git clone URL subprocess argv and repository route accepts github_token as a GET query parameter, risking exposure via process listings, logs, browser history, and referrers.
Acceptance: Replace argv URL credentials with safer credential flow (askpass/helper/header where feasible), avoid GET query token transport, and update tests.
Verification: uv run pytest tests/test_repository_checkout_service.py tests/test_generation_api.py -q

Verification: uv run pytest targeted tests; uv run ruff check src tests.

notes:
Dependency handling update: user requested latest package versions and MCP/tool-assisted checks. Context7 lookups attempted for FastAPI/LiteLLM/pydantic-settings but failed due invalid Context7 API key. Used uv resolver and `uv tree --outdated` to identify latest direct package floors, then refreshed pyproject/uv.lock with `uv add --raw` latest lower bounds. Verified initial API slice with `uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py -q` and `uv run ruff check src tests`.
Progress update: Direct backend dependencies refreshed to latest resolved versions with uv. Verified direct outdated check with `uv tree --depth 1 --outdated` (no latest markers on direct deps). Repomix latest checked via `npm view repomix version` = 1.14.0; ingestion service uses `npx --yes repomix@latest` as primary strategy, with gitingest fallback when npx is unavailable and tree-sitter-analyzer for structural file summaries. Added safe project-bounded AI analysis tools (`glob`, `read`, `traverse`, `rg`) for multi-step analysis. Verified `uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py tests/test_analysis_tools.py tests/test_ingestion_service.py -q` = 14 passed; `uv run ruff check src tests` = all checks passed. Note: full `uv tree --outdated` still reports some transitive grammar packages constrained by `tree-sitter-analyzer[all-languages]` 1.11.1; direct project deps are current.
Added explicit multi-stage local AI analysis pipeline: `ProjectClassifier` detects project type/languages/frameworks/package managers/entrypoints; `RankedContextBuilder` applies robust ignores and scores files using profile hints; `RepositoryIngestionService.build_context()` now classifies -> selects relevant files -> tree-sitter-analyzes top files -> packs selected files with Repomix or falls back to ranked text context. Verified with `uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py tests/test_analysis_tools.py tests/test_context_ranking.py tests/test_ingestion_service.py tests/test_project_classifier.py tests/test_multistage_ingestion.py tests/test_resume_generation.py -q` = 20 passed and `uv run ruff check src tests` = all checks passed.
Expanded staged analysis pipeline to support major code languages. `ProjectClassifier` now detects Python, JS/TS, Java, Go, Rust, C/C++, C#, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby, SQL, HTML/CSS, Markdown, YAML/JSON, shell/PowerShell, Swift, Scala, R, Lua, Elixir and emits relevant globs. Ranking now scores these languages and common high-value paths (controllers/handlers/middleware/cmd/internal/pkg/contracts/migrations), plus frameworks including React/Vite/Next/Angular/Vue/Svelte/FastAPI/Django/Flask/LiteLLM/Spring Boot/Gin/Actix. Verified with `uv run pytest ... -q` = 22 passed, `uv run ruff check src tests` = all checks passed, and `uv tree --depth 1 --outdated` shows direct deps current.
